entries.en: You have any idea who I am? Fucking thought so.
entries.ro: Ai habar cine sunt? Știam eu, pula mea.

entries.en: Mhm, like what I see, baby. But I am busy.
entries.ro: Mhm, îmi place ce văd, baby. Dar sunt ocupat.

entries.en: Then stop calling me every fucking second...
entries.ro: Atunci nu mă mai suna în fiecare pula mea de secundă...

entries.en: I don't wanna hear about problems, OK? Just do what you have to do...
entries.ro: Nu vreau să aud de probleme, OK? Fă ce trebuie să faci...
Mă simt atât de viu, pula mea!

entries.en: Got something to say, then say it.
The fuck you doing, some kinda mating ritual?
entries.ro: Ce căcat faci, vreun ritual de împerechere?

entries.en: We'll talk when you're done... Yes, today...
Mh-hm... Look, I'm not your babysitter, OK...? Yeah...
entries.ro: Mh-hm... Uite, nu sunt bona ta, OK...? Da...
